correctness.rationale: For bounded periodic scalar a,b with inf |b|>0 and positive noise sigma, variation of constants conditional on the sampled state gives R(K)=(G+int_S v)^2+sigma² int_S v² for v=e^(A(tau)-A(s)) b(s)K(s). Splitting v into its constant mean and L²-orthogonal residual uniquely minimizes R at v=-G/(ell+sigma²), giving R_*=G²sigma²/(ell+sigma²) and an admissible shape independent of S placement. Independent increments imply E X_(k tau)²=R^k X0²; bounded within-period moments yield full-time stability iff R<1. Constant-coefficient ZOH square-completion yields ell_ZOH=(2/a)tanh(a tau/2), strict ell_ZOH<tau and ratio (a tau/2)coth(a tau/2). Independent computation at a=tau=1,sigma²=.15 yields shaped 0.963789926<1 versus ZOH 1.031765975>1.

value.rationale: This solves a motivated actuator allocation and sampled-feedback feasibility problem: precise necessary/sufficient noisy activation duration for arbitrary measurable on-sets with no gain constraint, and a strict quantifiable implementation penalty when waveform shaping is forbidden. It identifies robust-looking placement invariance under explicitly limited assumptions rather than a routine bound.

limitations: Scalar control-linear Brownian noise, regular exact sampling, deterministic period-repeated L² waveform, measurable S, b bounded away from zero, no peak input bound; not matrix/control-jitter/observation-noise generality.
